title: Joining the Masons and red beans and rice at graves
summary: He was persuaded to join the Masons, dropped out in the Depression, and tells a story about flowers and red beans at graves.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
